title: 第1章 黑蛇第2章 五十年后
content_zh:
炎日当空，蝉鸣噪耳，夏日午后的山林闷热无风。
山脊上，古松在高温炙烤下渗出粘稠松脂，地面积着厚厚干枯松针，谷底溪水潺潺流淌。
起初，远山之巅浮现不自然的灰线。
灰色烟云无声翻滚膨胀迅猛接近，突然，多处山火毫无征兆翻过山岭，猩红烈焰沿着山林脉络肆意流淌铺展，树冠燃烧形成摇曳的火海。
粗壮树木发出悲鸣声轰然倒塌，顺着陡坡碾轧碰撞滑行，激起冲天烈焰和翻涌的灰烬。
热浪裹挟燃烧碎屑腾空，如纸钱纷纷扬扬抛向更远处，为万物送葬。
岩石表层受不住高温炙烤，骤然炸裂碎屑四溅。
半山，某处浅窄岩缝，一条两尺长黑蛇本能的往深处蜷缩，依靠岩石渗出的清凉泉水降温活命。
黑蛇茫然吐着蛇信，有限的意识无法理解正在发生的事情。
岩缝太浅了，它徒劳无意义的蜷缩缓慢蠕动，希望能获得更多凉意。
隙外烟尘浑浊如垂死的黄昏，模糊的阴暗中一簇簇烈焰明灭，风挟着星火呜咽低啸，燃烧的老松轰然倒塌，溅起炭火落到身上，疼的黑蛇翻转扭曲，意识被剧痛撕扯，在这焚风炼狱之中，黑蛇浑噩意识深处悄然滋生了情绪，恐惧，并记住了热感应看到的漫天赤红……
一条生于尘土长于草莽，本应在原始本能中平凡而终的野蛇，竟在这场山火中突破极限，被绝望催生出不应该有的灵智。
绝境中完成残酷启蒙，明白了何为恐惧。
它是这炽热炼狱中的囚徒，不识灾厄，不知始终，艰难依靠滴水岩缝庇护活着。
不知过去多久，山火远去，残留余温仍旧很热。
幸存的黑蛇感受到了从未经历过的寂静，有限的视野看到灰烬簌簌落定，以及冒着青烟的焦黑树桩。
茫然吞吐蛇信试图找到熟悉的山林气息，然而只有难闻的焦糊味。
忽然，黑蛇感受到轻微震动。
起初稀疏的钝响越来越急，最终汇成一片喧嚣鼎沸，绵密噼啪声从四面八方涌来。
这种节奏如此熟悉。

冷雨穿过浓烟砸进余烬，带来凉意驱散燥热。
凭借着刚刚萌发的有限灵性，黑蛇重新认识了习以为常的雨，诞生了新的情感认知，喜爱。
它缓缓游出浅窄狭缝，谨慎的昂首，用热感应观看世界。
耐心读取世界的冷却进程，通过外界细微温度变化，在脑海中构成一幅流动变幻画面。
享受雨滴敲击鳞片时的细微震动和清凉。
分叉蛇信品尝雨水味道，鼻孔贪婪呼吸雨水的清冽气息，尽情表达对雨的喜爱。
山里白茫茫。
黑蛇呼吸清凉雨气……
天光渐黯，雨势没有丝毫停歇迹象，陡坡失去草木无法存水，混合灰烬和泥土的水流冲刷出一条条沟壑，越往山下越狂暴，最终形成浑浊泥石流，裹挟石块和未燃尽的树木，以及被山洪淘挖出来的树根，轰隆隆奔腾。
杂物在狭窄处堆积阻塞，山洪蓄势，而后以更大的力量造成溃决，如此一次次循环。
黑蛇早已退回狭窄岩缝藏身。
察觉地面异常剧烈震动，它不知道也不会去思考发生了什么。
content_en:
The hot sun is in the sky, the cicadas are chirping noisily, and the mountain forest is sultry and windless in the summer afternoon.
On the ridges, ancient pines exude sticky rosin due to the high temperature. The ground is covered with thick dry pine needles, and streams gurgling at the bottom of the valley.
At first, an unnatural gray line appeared on the top of the distant mountain.
The gray smoke clouds rolled silently, expanded and approached rapidly. Suddenly, multiple mountain fires rolled over the mountains without warning. Scarlet flames flowed and spread along the veins of the mountain forests, and the tree crowns burned to form a swaying sea of ​​​​fire.
The thick trees screamed and collapsed, colliding and sliding along the steep slope, stirring up flames and tumbling ashes.
The heat wave carried the burning debris into the air, flying like paper money and throwing it farther away, mourning the death of all things.
The surface of the rock could not withstand the high temperature and suddenly burst into pieces and scattered debris.
Halfway up the mountain, in a shallow rock crevice, a two-foot-long black snake instinctively curled up deeper, relying on the cool spring water seeping out of the rock to cool down and survive.
The black snake spat out the snake letter blankly, and its limited consciousness could not understand what was happening.
The rock crevice was too shallow, and it curled up and squirmed in vain, hoping to get more coolness.
The smoke and dust outside the gap were as turbid as the dying dusk, and clusters of flames flickered out in the vague darkness. The wind whimpered and whistled with the sparks. The burning old pine collapsed, splashing charcoal fire and falling on the body. The painful black snake turned and twisted, and its consciousness was torn apart by severe pain. In this burning wind purgatory, the black snake quietly grew emotions, fear, and remembered the red sky seen by the heat sensor...
A wild snake that was born in the dust and grew in the grass, and should have died an ordinary life in primitive instincts, actually broke through its limits in this wildfire, and was driven by despair to develop a wisdom that it should not have.
Completed cruel enlightenment in a desperate situation, and understood what fear is.
It is a prisoner in this fiery purgatory. It does not know the disaster or the end, and it lives hard relying on the protection of dripping water and cracks in the rocks.
I don’t know how much time has passed, but the mountain fire has gone away, but the remaining temperature is still very hot.
The surviving black snakes felt the silence they had never experienced before, and their limited vision saw the ashes settling and the blackened tree stumps emitting green smoke.
He stammered the snake letter in confusion, trying to find the familiar smell of the mountains and forests, but there was only an unpleasant burnt smell.
Suddenly, Black Snake felt a slight vibration.
The dull sounds that were sparse at first became more and more urgent, and finally merged into a din, with dense crackling sounds coming from all directions.
This rhythm is so familiar.
The cold rain penetrated the thick smoke and smashed into the embers, bringing coolness to dispel the heat.
With the limited spirituality that had just sprouted, Black Snake reacquainted himself with the rain that he was accustomed to, and gave birth to a new emotional recognition and love.
It slowly swam out of the shallow narrow slit, raised its head cautiously, and used its thermal sensors to view the world.
Patiently read the cooling process of the world, and form a flowing and changing picture in your mind through the subtle temperature changes in the outside world.
Enjoy the subtle vibrations and coolness of raindrops hitting your scales.
The Forked Snake Xin tastes the taste of rainwater, and breathes in the clear breath of rainwater with greedy nostrils, expressing its love for rain.
The mountains are white.
The black snake breathes the cool rain...
The sky was fading, and the rain showed no sign of letting up. The steep slopes lost their vegetation and could not store water. The water flow mixed with ashes and soil washed out gullies, which became more violent as they went down the mountain. Eventually, they formed a muddy mudslide, carrying rocks, unburned trees, and tree roots dug out by flash floods, roaring and roaring.
Debris accumulates and blocks the narrow place, flash floods gather momentum, and then burst with greater force, and the cycle continues again and again.
The black snake had already retreated into the narrow rock crevice to hide.
It noticed that the ground was shaking extremely violently, and it didn't know or think about what happened.
